I graded s2 and wrote `grades/0001-s2.json`: 3 correct, 2 partial, 1 wrong.

| Item | Verdict | Feedback |
|---|---|---|
| q1 | correct | The loop is what makes a system an agent. |
| q2 | correct | The model only outputs a tool request, and the program runs the tool. |
| q3 | wrong (M6) | You chose "it will eventually fix the bug". A stuck agent needs a stopping condition, such as a step limit. More steps just cost more. |
| q4 | partial (M4) | 4 is the right count. Your reason said the model runs the tools, but the program runs them. The count is the question plus three tool results, so four model calls. |
| q5 | correct | You gave both parts: the result goes back as the next input, and the model uses it to decide its next step. |
| q6 | partial | The name is only part of it. The model reads the whole tool description: name, purpose and parameters. |

You have the loop down. The two gaps are that the model requests tools and the program runs them, and that every loop needs a stopping condition.

I also added `learning-records/0003-quiz-0001-spaced-retrieval.md` and updated `NOTES.md`. `s1` is still ungraded.
